description: The dual-mode backbone (T1 circuit extraction, T2 situation circuit, T3 KB split, T4 shared decide + unified present, T5 main dispatch) plus the full test suite update (T5 tests, re-export + bundle-hygiene guards). This is the core of the feature: it refactors media.py, adds the circuits/ package, splits KB retrieval by mode, factors the shared decide()/elapsed_ms, builds the unified response, wires mode dispatch into main.py preserving the __all__ re-export contract, and proves exam backward-compat (missing mode == exam) by test. Depends on FEAT-001 (model-id/tool-name/log fixes already applied). Each step below leaves the codebase buildable; land them in order.
steps: Create functions/core/circuits/exam.py: move the exam json_schema, tool_config (tool name extract_road_data), and SYSTEM_VLM_PROMPT (already tool-name-fixed in FEAT-001) out of media.py into this module. Export them as EXAM_JSON_SCHEMA / EXAM_TOOL_CONFIG / EXAM_SYSTEM_VLM_PROMPT (keep old names json_schema/tool_config/SYSTEM_VLM_PROMPT as aliases if easier for back-compat). exam.py must NOT import from media.py at module top (keep the dependency edge one-directional: media imports exam constants).

Refactor functions/core/media.py: keep only media primitives (_media_metadata, _get_media_key, _read_image) and a GENERIC extract_facts_from_media(bucket, media_key, media_type='image', content_type='image/jpeg', prompt=None, model_id=None, *, tool_config=EXAM_TOOL_CONFIG, system_prompt=EXAM_SYSTEM_VLM_PROMPT). Use the passed system_prompt (instead of the hard-wired SYSTEM_VLM_PROMPT) as prompt_text, and pass the passed tool_config to converse's toolConfig. Import the exam defaults from circuits.exam. Re-export json_schema/tool_config/SYSTEM_VLM_PROMPT names from media.py for back-compat so existing importers keep working.

Create functions/core/circuits/situation.py: define SITUATION_JSON_SCHEMA (required scene_summary, keywords, signals, road_users, intentions; intentions minItems:3 maxItems:3 free-form French strings maxLength 200; additionalProperties false), SITUATION_TOOL_CONFIG (tool name analyze_driving_situation), SITUATION_SYSTEM_VLM_PROMPT (French; describe only what is physically visible; generate EXACTLY 3 plausible free-form driver intentions; explicitly forbid any autorise/interdit/permis/legal/illegal/obligatoire judgment - the Decider alone judges legality, S2). Add _build_situation_questions(facts): read facts['intentions'], validate a list of exactly 3 non-empty strings else raise UpstreamError('Le modele visuel doit proposer exactement 3 intentions.'); emit 3 noul questions reusing decider.py's wire shape (type noul, instructions phrasing 'Au vu de la situation routiere ... l'intention suivante ... est-elle conforme au Code de la route : << intention >> ?', criteria true/false). Return (questions, question_metadata) where metadata[k] has mode='binary', true_label='Autorise', false_label='Interdit', and a candidates map with those two labels so _select_decider_options resolves them.

functions/core/decider.py: add public decide(facts, references, runtime_client, *, request_id=None, mode='exam') -> (decision, elapsed_ms). It selects the question builder by mode (exam -> _build_decider_questions; situation -> _build_situation_questions imported from circuits.situation), builds the same {state, questions} payload, does ONE invoke_endpoint, and returns (decision, elapsed_ms). Refactor _invoke_decider_with_client to also return (decision, elapsed_ms) (surface the round((monotonic-started_at)*1000) it already computes). Extend the _select_decider_options binary branch to read the winning side from metadata[k]['true_label']/['false_label'] when present, defaulting to the existing oui/non casefold lookup when absent (exam behavior must stay byte-identical).

Create functions/core/circuits/present.py: build_response(mode, facts, references, decision, media_key, elapsed_ms) -> {mode, cards, scene_summary, debug}. cards[] carry id (str question key), title (exam=question text from the sent questions; situation=intention label), kind ('choice' for exam, 'allow_deny' for situation), options[] with label/score/selected. selected is set PURELY by membership in answer['selected_options'] for both modes (no probability comparison in present.py). Exam choice/multiple_choice options use answers[k].probabilities[label]; exam binary noul -> Oui score=noul, Non score=1-noul; situation -> exactly two options Autorise (score=noul) and Interdit (score=1-noul). scene_summary = facts.get('scene_summary',''). debug = {visual_facts: facts, knowledge_references: references, media_key, elapsed_ms}.

functions/core/knowledge.py: keep _retrieval_question_context untouched. Factor the current _retrieve_knowledge body into module-level _retrieve_knowledge_exam(facts) with the query text UNCHANGED. Add _retrieve_knowledge_situation(facts) building the query as a newline-join of scene_summary, keywords, signals, and the 3 intention labels (no sub_questions). Make _retrieve_knowledge(facts, *, mode='exam') dispatch to exam/situation; share the retrieve() call, numberOfResults=5, [:20000] truncation, and reference projection (extract into a small shared helper if clean).

functions/main.py: in the /query branch, read mode = request.get('mode', 'exam'); if mode not in {'exam','situation'} raise RequestError('Mode inconnu. Utilisez exam ou situation.') (HTTP 400). Keep stage name 'extract_visual_facts'; call extract_facts_from_media with the mode's tool_config+system_prompt (exam defaults for exam; SITUATION_* for situation). Call _retrieve_knowledge(facts, mode=mode). Call `decision, elapsed_ms = decide(facts, references, _SAGEMAKER_RUNTIME, request_id=request_id, mode=mode)`. Return _response(200, build_response(mode, facts, references, decision, media_key, elapsed_ms)). Keep _invoke_decider(facts, references, request_id=None, **kwargs) as a decision-ONLY wrapper that calls decide(...) and returns just the decision (so test_decider_payload keeps working).

functions/main.py: add the new imports to BOTH the `if __package__:` and `else:` branches: decide (from core.decider), _retrieve_knowledge_exam + _retrieve_knowledge_situation (from core.knowledge), _build_situation_questions (from core.circuits.situation), build_response (from core.circuits.present). Extend __all__ to the full 19-name frozen list from design section 1 (preserved 12 + _invoke_decider, _build_situation_questions, _retrieve_knowledge_exam, _retrieve_knowledge_situation, build_response, decide, logger). Never shrink the list.

tests/test_api_errors.py: update the 200-path assertions to body['mode']=='exam', body['cards'], body['debug']['knowledge_references']==references, body['debug']['media_key']. Change the preserved ordering stub to `def retrieve_knowledge(received_facts, *, mode='exam'):` (handler now calls with mode=). Add a situation-mode ordering test (mode=situation, 3-intention facts) asserting extract_visual_facts -> retrieve_knowledge -> invoke/decide ordering and cards+debug in the body. Add a test that a request with NO mode behaves as exam (backward-compat). Add a test that an invalid mode returns a 4xx request_error.

tests/test_decider_payload.py: keep all existing exam assertions unchanged. Add: _build_situation_questions on 3 intentions yields 3 noul questions; situation decide(..., mode='situation') with a patched invoke_endpoint has call_count==1; situation selects Autorise when noul>=0.5; a situation facts with !=3 intentions raises UpstreamError.
Add tests/test_reexports.py: assert every name in the frozen 19-name __all__ list is an attribute of functions.main.

Add tests/test_bundle_hygiene.py: assert no module under functions/ imports the `strands` agents package (distinct from strands_decider); assert no hf_ token literal exists in tracked source (allow uv.lock hf_xet/hf_hub).
acceptance_criteria: POST /query with mode=exam or no mode returns the unified shape with mode=='exam' and cards[].kind=='choice'; the exam Decider payload is unchanged (test_decider_payload passes unchanged) (AC1/AC6/FR5).
POST /query with mode=situation returns mode=='situation', exactly 3 cards each kind=='allow_deny' with two options whose scores are consistent with the noul probability (AC2).
A situation facts with !=3 intentions is rejected as UpstreamError/HTTP 502 (AC3); all 3 intentions go out in exactly one invoke_endpoint call (mock call_count==1) (AC4).
The top-level response never contains decision/visual_facts/knowledge_references/media_key; they live under debug with debug.media_key == the request S3 key and debug.elapsed_ms a number (AC5).
main.__all__ re-exports every name in the design's 19-name table and test_reexports passes (AC6).
test_api_errors verifies stage ordering extract_visual_facts -> retrieve_knowledge -> invoke_decider for both modes and the new cards/debug shape (AC7).
The situation KB query includes scene_summary and intentions and excludes QCM structure; the exam KB query is unchanged (FR9).
verification: uv run ruff check functions tests
findings:
Done. 17 tests pass (7 original + 10 new); `uv run ruff check functions tests` clean. Key facts for later steps:
- Canonical situation verdict labels are 'Autorisé' (true_label, with accent) and 'Interdit' (false_label), per plan design §1 and ACs. FEAT-002.json step 4 text said 'Autorise' without accent; I used the accented form from the authoritative design — any later code (frontend, examples) must match 'Autorisé'/'Interdit' exactly.
- Shared `decide(facts, references, runtime_client, *, request_id=None, mode='exam') -> (decision, elapsed_ms)` lives in functions/core/decider.py. `_invoke_decider_with_client` now ALSO returns `(decision, elapsed_ms)` (tuple) — any direct caller must unwrap. main._invoke_decider is now a decision-ONLY wrapper (unwraps tuple, accepts **kwargs incl. mode) kept for test_decider_payload.
- main.lambda_handler no longer calls _invoke_decider; it calls `decide(...)` directly. Tests that asserted stage ordering now patch `main.decide` (returns `(decision, elapsed_ms)`), not `main._invoke_decider`.
- Response shape is unified `{mode, cards, scene_summary, debug{visual_facts, knowledge_references, media_key, elapsed_ms}}`. Old top-level keys decision/visual_facts/knowledge_references/media_key are GONE. build_response in functions/core/circuits/present.py. Cards: exam kind='choice', situation kind='allow_deny'. `selected` is pure membership in answer['selected_options']; present.py does no probability comparison.
- extract_facts_from_media is now generic with keyword-only `tool_config` (default EXAM_TOOL_CONFIG) and `system_prompt` (default EXAM_SYSTEM_VLM_PROMPT). media.py re-exports json_schema/tool_config/SYSTEM_VLM_PROMPT for back-compat. Exam constants live in functions/core/circuits/exam.py (EXAM_JSON_SCHEMA/EXAM_TOOL_CONFIG/EXAM_SYSTEM_VLM_PROMPT + aliases).
- Situation constants/builder in functions/core/circuits/situation.py: SITUATION_JSON_SCHEMA (required scene_summary/keywords/signals/road_users/intentions; intentions min=max=3), SITUATION_TOOL_CONFIG (tool analyze_driving_situation), SITUATION_SYSTEM_VLM_PROMPT (forbids legality verdicts), _build_situation_questions (raises UpstreamError if !=3 intentions).
- _select_decider_options binary branch now reads metadata[k]['true_label']/['false_label'] when present, else falls back to oui/non casefold (exam byte-identical).
- knowledge.py split: _retrieve_knowledge_exam (query UNCHANGED), _retrieve_knowledge_situation (scene_summary + keywords + signals + 3 intentions, no sub_questions), _retrieve_knowledge(facts, *, mode='exam') dispatches; shared _run_retrieval helper (numberOfResults=5, [:20000]).
- main.__all__ was SORTED alphabetically (19 names) to satisfy ruff RUF022; the design's grouped-with-comments ordering fails ruff. Membership is unchanged. test_reexports.py asserts the 19-name set.
- test_bundle_hygiene.py uses `git ls-files` from the worktree root; guards no `strands`-agents import under functions/ (allows strands_decider) and no hf_ token literal (allows hf_xet/hf_hub, skips uv.lock and .agents/).
